mocks.description: Validates account opening against bank policies
Creates a new bank account in core banking system

rules.responseBody:
{
  "error": {
    "message": "Account creation failed",
    "code": "validation_error",
    "description": "Account data validation failed"
  },
  "failureReason": "invalid_account_name",
  "failureCategory": "validation_error",
  "canRetry": true,
  "retryAfter": 300,
  "maxRetries": 3,
  "recommendations": [
    "Please check your account information and try again",
    "Account name must be between 1-50 characters"
  ],
  "supportReference": "{{helpers.guid()}}"
}

mocks.description: LOV: branches catalog, filterable by currency. Drives branchCode x-lov (cascade with $form.currency) on demand-deposit-input, time-deposit-input, investment-account-input, savings-account-input schemas.

Lookup: branch detail (address, phone, manager) by code. Drives branchCode x-lookup on account-opening-master schema; result is exposed under $lookup.branchDetail in account-confirmation-view. Returns 404 for unknown codes.
